name: Home page renders and index navigation reaches the simulations
description: Verifies the personal page loads with all sections, the copyright footer, and working in-page index links.
steps: Open the home page
Confirm the large heading reads Numa Koudsie and the footer contains the words © 2026 Numa Koudsie
Click the Simulations link in the Index navigation
expected: The section headed Interactive physics simulations is visible, showing eight simulation cards labelled Fig. 1 to Fig. 8, each with a Launch button, followed by a button reading All simulations.

name: Simulations page lists every figure, filters by field and searches
covers: links between catalog and simulation pages
description: The dedicated simulations page draws one card per simulation from the registry, in figure order, titled with its name; the cards open as closed titles, and a field chip or a search opens what it finds, each with a picture, an abstract and its key equation typeset as in LaTeX; the cards link to and from the simulation pages.
steps: Open the home page and click the button Open the simulations near the top
Confirm the page heading reads Simulations, that ten closed cards are listed in order, numbered 01 to 10 and titled Wave Interference to Wind Turbine Control, and that the text 10 shown appears
Click the chip Wave optics

Confirm only the cards Wave Interference (01) and Double-Slit Interference (03) are shown, each opened with a picture, a typeset equation and a button starting with Open Fig., and the text 2 of 10 shown appears
Click the chip All fields, type runge in the search box
Confirm only the card Double Pendulum is shown, opened, and the text 1 of 10 shown appears
Click its button Open Fig. 2, then click the link All simulations at the top left of the simulation page
Search for zzzzzzzz and confirm the empty catalog is hidden without a blank list margin; clear the search and confirm all ten cards return.
expected: The simulation page opens with the heading Double Pendulum, and the top-left link returns to the simulations page with the heading Simulations.

name: Double pendulum runs, pauses and shows the chaos twin
covers: simulation deep link with spaces in file name
description: Verifies the double pendulum page loads in the site style and responds to its controls.
steps: Open the home page
In the simulations section, click the Launch button on the Double Pendulum Chaos card
On the opened page, switch on the Chaos twin toggle
Click the Pause button
expected: The page shows the heading Double Pendulum, the Twin separation readout shows a value in metres instead of twin off, and the button now reads Play.

name: Double-slit page renders Greek letters and path difference
description: Verifies the double-slit page shows correct Greek symbols and a computed path difference.
steps: Open the home page
In the simulations section, click the Launch button on the Double-Slit Interference card
Set Slit separation b to 40 px and Wavelength lambda to 20 px
Confirm Fig. 3b includes the bright-fringe label m = 1 at its thirty-degree edge
expected: The opened page shows the heading Double-Slit Interference, a control labelled Angle with the Greek letter alpha and a degree value such as 20.0°, and a readout labelled δs exact with a value in px; no garbled characters such as Î± appear. At b = 40 px and lambda = 20 px the pattern also labels m = 1 at thirty degrees.

name: Wave workbench builds a square wave and removes a wave on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile layout of the superposition workbench, its square-wave preset and wave removal.
steps: Open the home page
Tap the Launch button on the Wave Interference Simulator card
On the opened page, tap the Square wave button
Tap the remove button in the Wave 4 panel
expected: After the preset, panels Wave 1 to Wave 4 were shown; after removal only Wave 1, Wave 2 and Wave 3 remain and the Waves readout shows 3 / 6.

name: Fig. 1 data panel lists the variables, opens the field as a table and records one round
description: Verifies the side panel on the wave interference page shows the simulation's numbers at one caught instant, opens an array as a table, and records one round of the running simulation as charts.
steps: Open the home page
In the simulations section, click the Launch button on the Wave Interference – Multiple Sources card
On the opened page, if the data panel is not open, click the Data tab on the right edge of the window
In the data panel's Variables list, click the entry for the array C
Click the button labelled All variables, then click the Record button near the top of the panel and wait three seconds
expected: The Variables list shows numbered sections such as Physical parameters, with the wavelength λ at 30 px and a line that starts with Values at t =; the array C opens as a table of numbers with its shape shown as rows × columns; after Record, a progress bar fills and the Rounds tab opens with the heading Round 1, a summary naming one period of the sources, and one small chart per quantity.

name: Double pendulum data panel shows the state vector and conserved energy
description: Verifies the data panel on the double pendulum page lists the integrator's state and energy and opens the state vector as a table.
steps: Open the home page
In the simulations section, click the Launch button on the Double Pendulum Chaos card
On the opened page, if the data panel is not open, click the Data tab on the right edge of the window
In the Variables table, click the row for the state vector y
expected: The data panel lists a group headed Energy with rows T, V, E and ε, and the state vector y opens as a table with four rows named θ₁, θ₂, ω₁ and ω₂ and columns value, unit and d/dt.

name: Fig. 6 Read values pins a point of the figure and checks a value three ways
description: Verifies that the Read values switch under the wave workbench pins a point of the figure, shows its stored values in a strip under the figure, opens the three-way check of one value, and offers the dataset as a download.
steps: Open the home page
In the simulations section, click the Launch button on the Wave Interference Simulator card
Click the Read values button at the right end of the caption under the figure
Click on the black sum curve in the upper half of the figure
In the strip under the figure, click the value labelled Σ yᵢ
In the data panel that opens, click Back, then click the download button in the panel header
expected: Moving the pointer across the figure before pressing Read values shows nothing over the figure; after Read values and the click, a ring marker sits on the curve and the strip under the figure lists X, Σ yᵢ and y px with numeric values; clicking Σ yᵢ opens the data panel at a check with three numbered sections, Stored in the dataset, Recomputed now from the stored inputs, and Read back from the picture, with the line Stored and recomputed identical; the download button saves a zip file whose name starts with fig6-wave-bench.

name: Phone: the data sheet records one round of the water waves
description: Verifies that on a phone the data panel opens as a bottom sheet, records one period of the water-wave simulation and shows it as charts.
steps: Open the home page
Tap the Launch button on the Circular Water Waves card
On the opened page, tap the Data button at the bottom right
Tap the Record button in the sheet and wait three seconds
expected: The sheet slides up with the title Water waves and a box headed Record one round that names one period, T = … s; after Record the Rounds tab shows Round 1 with a line counting the samples and frames, and charts for quantities such as ξ and ζ at the point.

name: Driven oscillator solves the run first and plays it back
description: The driven oscillator computes its whole 60 s run before drawing, stores it, plays the stored samples back, and carries a lecture note with typeset equations.
steps: Open simulations/driven-oscillator.html
Confirm the status under the Solve button begins with Solved 60000 RK4 steps and mentions 6001 samples
Click Pause and confirm the button now reads Play
Scroll down to the lecture note headed Driven oscillations: how a system answers a push it does not control
In lecture-note Figure 2, confirm both frequency-ratio axes read 0.1, 0.32, 1, 3.2, 10; the amplitude peak is near ratio 1.
expected: The lecture note shows an Abstract box, numbered sections and typeset equations, and the figure above shows a block on a spring with the stored curve x(t) beneath it.

name: Wind turbine re-solves when the controller changes
description: Changing the controller marks the stored run as out of date until Solve is pressed again.
steps: Open simulations/wind-turbine.html
Confirm the status begins with Solved 12000 RK4 steps
Click the button Follow the wind
Confirm the status now begins with A control changed
Click Solve
In lecture-note Figure 2, confirm p in c_p and opt in lambda_opt appear as subscripts without literal underscores.
expected: The status again begins with Solved 12000 RK4 steps, and the readout Rotor speed shows a range in rpm.

name: Portfolios page opens the droplet project
description: The Portfolios page introduces the Droplet Collection project, whose static copy opens in a sub-folder and links back.
steps: Open portfolios.html
Confirm the heading reads Portfolios and a project titled Droplet Collection with four figures is shown
Click Open the project
Confirm a page titled How cloud droplets become rain appears, with the pages Overview, Theory, Results, Simulate and Checks in its top bar
Click the link Numa Koudsie · Portfolios at the top left
Scroll through the four Droplet Collection figures and confirm their reserved proportions agree with the loaded pictures.
expected: The Portfolios page with the heading Portfolios is shown again.

name: Wave bench handles a slow repeat and an empty sum
description: Verifies nearby wave frequencies use the twenty-second recording cap and removing every wave clears the stored sum.
steps: Open simulations/wave-interference.html and choose Beats
Set Wave 2 Frequency to 1.05 and Speed to 0.95; open Data
Confirm Record one round describes twenty seconds of the pattern, 20.00 s
Close Data and remove both waves
Open Data, then open the y_sum array in Variables and check one of its zero-valued entries
expected: The empty bench has no wave cards and its sum array is zero; Check says Stored and recomputed identical.

name: Phasor recording explains zero speed and resumes at positive speed
description: Verifies Speed 0 cannot silently start a round that never advances, and positive speed permits a complete round.
steps: Open simulations/phasor-sums.html
Set Speed to 0, open Data, and press Record
Confirm the message says Set Speed above 0 because phasor time does not advance
Close Data, set Speed to 1, reopen Data, and press Record
Wait five seconds
Switch Smooth morphing off, open walkthrough step 7, and confirm its alpha Now value is 1.00 even when the Morph rate slider is below 1.
expected: At Speed 0 the panel explains why recording cannot start. At Speed 1 one full figure finishes and the Rounds tab displays Round 1.

name: Home fold tools align at the intermediate breakpoint
description: Checks the former 970 px gap without changing the protected home scenario.
steps: Open the home page at a 970 px viewport.
Confirm the index is a full-width bar and the Expand all and Collapse all tools have a 48 px top margin.
Check there is no sideways page scroll.
Use Collapse all, then Expand all, and confirm the five home sections close and reopen.
expected: The tools align below the index with a 48 px margin and the page has no sideways scroll.

name: Stored results drive the visible values
covers: stored turbine range and captured share
description: Checks the pipeline fixes through visible controls and data.
steps: Open simulations/wave-interference.html and choose Square.
Open Data and inspect f: the first four frequencies are 0.4, 1.2, 2, 2.8.
Open simulations/wind-turbine.html and wait for Solve.
Open Data and verify steps is 12000; rpm_min, rpm_max and captured_pct match the readouts.
expected: Square frequencies have no spurious decimal tails. Turbine results agree with their stored values.

name: Shared simulation tools survive unused-code cleanup
description: Exercises the shared paths retained during the final cleanup.
steps: Open simulations/water-wave.html at phone width.
Open the walkthrough and confirm the equation and Now values render.
Open Data, inspect a stored value and its Check, then save the dataset.
Confirm the download is a ZIP containing metadata and NumPy data, and close Data.
expected: Walkthrough, Check, data download and close controls remain functional with no page errors.
